report.summary: The change deletes the early return in prepareArtifactMerge that handled a PR already marked merged. With it gone, preparing an already-merged PR throws PR_NOT_MERGEABLE when it used to return the stored mergeSha. That breaks three things. (1) The existing worker test 'prepares only open merges ... with stable retries' expects prepareArtifactMerge on a merged PR to return {pullRequest, mergeSha}, so it now fails (read, not run). (2) Retries break. A merge_pr operation that is not resuming a recorded push reaches prepareArtifactMerge with nothing to resume from: a retried merge action after a lost result, or a second request for the same merge. On an already-merged PR it now fails. It never reaches the code that sets the workspace prState to merged, so a workspace whose earlier attempt finished the D1 merge but not that update stays wrong. (3) Spec 09 says 'Retrying the action reconciles an already-pushed result before attempting another merge', and no spec change is included (CLAUDE.md rule 16). The similar check after a failed update, inside the `if (!updated)` branch, only runs for a PR that is open when first read, so it does not replace the deleted one.

findings.text: Preparing a PR that is already merged now throws PR_NOT_MERGEABLE instead of returning the stored mergeSha. Retrying a merge is no longer safe.

evidence.why: This line now runs first for a merged PR (state 'merged', mergeSha set) and throws. In steps.ts, git.merge calls `const merge = await prepareArtifactMerge(core.env, project, number);` whenever there is no pushedMergeSha in the operation's state or input. It relied on the `"mergeSha" in merge` result to skip the tempod merge and still run `core.updateWs({ prState: "merged", checksState: null })`. A retried merge action now fails, and the workspace prState is never reconciled. That contradicts 09 Git Forge.md: 'Retrying the action reconciles an already-pushed result before attempting another merge.'

findings.text: The existing test of the merged-PR retry still expects the old result, so the suite now fails. The change does not update the test or the spec.

evidence.why: This test runs completeArtifactMerge first, so the PR is merged when it calls prepareArtifactMerge, and it expects {pullRequest: merged, mergeSha: MERGED}. At the head commit that call rejects with PR_NOT_MERGEABLE, so `bun run test` fails (CLAUDE.md rule 15).

checked.risk: Idempotency and state: retrying a merge after a lost result or a partial failure
Failure paths: is the merged state still handled by the check that runs after a failed update
Tests: existing tests that cover the removed branch
Spec: native merge retry and reconciliation rules
Real contracts, security, build/runtime environment: not affected (the change only removes 3 lines in a TypeScript function and adds no calls, secrets or image changes)

ls docs; grep -rn -i "already merged\|mergeSha\|git.merge" docs | head -30; grep -rn "prepareArtifactMerge\|already merged" docs/IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md | head
